attributes.board_name: Louisiana State Board of Examiners of Psychologists

rules.accepted_credit_types: Auto-approved from acceptable sponsors: accredited colleges; hospitals/medical centers with CME centers or APA internships; professional associations offering graduate/postdoctoral CE; APA-approved sponsors (incl. APA home study); AMA PRA Category 1 from ACCME-accredited sponsors; LSBEP and Louisiana Department of Health. Live, virtual or prerecorded workshops, conferences, graduate courses
rules.notes: Rule amended June 2026: 30 h per biennial reporting period (July 1 - June 30) for reports due July 1, 2027 onward (previously 40 h). Even- and odd-numbered licensees report in alternate years; CE and certificates entered in the LSBEP portal. Licenses renew annually by July 31. Applies to psychologists, provisional psychologists and LPAs.
rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. LXIII, §803
rules.rule_quote: Each licensee is required to complete 30 hours or credits of continuing education within the biennial reporting period.
